There to stand gaping, Crowing and japing; Under hubbub loud, Through thronging crowd, Eel-like we slip off, All en masse trip off, A rumpus to raise. Whether you praise, Or whether you blame, To us it’s the same!

@@U02346@@
(Fawning greedily.)

@@U02347@@
Woodcutters lusty, You and your trusty Coal-burning kin, You are our men! For bowing, for scraping, Assenting and smiling, Grand phrases shaping, Obscure and beguiling, Meant to blow hot Or cold, or what not, The moment to please— What profit all these? Let fire be given In volume enormous, Straight out of heaven, If we had no billet, No charcoal to fill it, Our fireplace gaping, Pray, how would it warm us With heartening glow, With no coal clumps to throw? Steaming and roasting, Stewing and toasting! The grand gourmet Is the licker of dishes Who scents roast on the way, And has visions of fishes
translation:
@@U02344@@
站在那里目瞪口呆，啼叫和开玩笑；喧嚣声中，穿过拥挤的人群，我们像鳗鱼一样滑落，全体出发，一片喧闹。无论你赞扬，还是指责，对我们来说都是一样的！

@@U02346@@
（贪婪地阿谀奉承。）

@@U02347@@
精力充沛的樵夫，你和你值得信赖的燃煤亲戚，你是我们的男人！为了鞠躬，为了刮擦， 同意和微笑， 宏大的短语塑造， 晦涩和迷惑， 意味着吹热或冷，或什么不是， 取悦的时刻 - 所有这些有什么好处？让火从天而降，数量巨大，如果我们没有坯料，没有木炭来填充，我们的壁炉张开，祈祷，它如何用令人振奋的光芒温暖我们，没有煤块可以扔？蒸、烤、炖、烤！伟大的美食家是舔菜的人，路上闻到烤肉的香味，看到鱼的景象
